title: Maze Task
instructions:
•	Players trace a printed maze with their finger.
•	Letters are placed on corners and turns.
•	As the player moves from start to end, they write down each letter they pass.
•	Letters in order form their code.

title: Wiring Task
instructions:
•	A device (real or simulated) has 8 unlabeled pins, 4 LEDs, and 4 wires.
•	Player tries connecting the 4 wires into pins.
•	Correct wire → correct LED lights.
•	When all 4 LEDs are lit, a code appears on the screen.

title: Scavenger Hunt Task
instructions:
•	Paper slip tells player to go to a starting location.
•	On the wall there is a piece of paper with: 
o	The first letter of the code
o	A direction to the next location
•	Player follows directions to find 3–5 letters in order.

title: Collaborative Story Writing Task
instructions:
•	On a table: a paper with the first 4 sentences of a story.
•	Player must add 4 sentences continuing the story.
•	Staff checks their sentences and gives the player a code.

title: Encryption Task
instructions:
•	Player uses given a number to encrypt the given a code with Caesar cipher, then uses the encrypted code to encrypt the previously given code with Vigenère cipher, the final encrypted message is the code.
•	Direction to use ciphers is on the table, location described in crewmate slip.
